topics.title: Iron: Absorption & bioavailability
topics.context: Iron absorption is far more complex than simply eating iron-rich foods. Your body can absorb heme iron from animal sources up to three times more efficiently than plant-based iron, and factors like vitamin C, stomach acid, and gut health dramatically affect how much iron you actually retain.
takeaways: Heme iron (animal sources) is absorbed 15-35% vs 2-20% for non-heme iron (plant sources)
Vitamin C increases non-heme iron absorption by up to 3x when eaten together
Tea, coffee, and calcium can inhibit iron absorption when consumed with meals
